1. Site Supervision and Compliance

· Monitor civil construction activities against approved drawings, specifications, and method statements.

· Verify that contractor execution complies with project requirements.

· Identify discrepancies, deviations, and potential construction risks.

· Escalate unauthorized changes and non-compliant work to the Project Coordinator.

2. Progress and Schedule Control

· Verify actual physical progress against the approved project schedule.

· Monitor contractor manpower, equipment, productivity, and work fronts.

· Identify potential delays and assess their impact on project milestones.

· Report deviations and recommend corrective actions to the Project Coordinator.

3. Quality Assurance and Inspection

· Witness and verify inspections and tests in accordance with the Inspection and Test Plan (ITP).

· Monitor workmanship, material compliance, and inspection records.

· Record defects and non-conformities and track corrective actions.

· Verify rectification before recommending acceptance by the authorized party.

4. Contractor Performance Monitoring

· Monitor contractor compliance with contractual scope, approved work plans, and site requirements.

· Assess manpower adequacy and construction readiness.

· Coordinate with contractor supervisors and consultants to resolve site issues.

· Escalate inadequate resources, repeated non-compliance, and poor performance.

5. Reporting and Documentation

· Prepare daily site reports and weekly progress updates.

· Maintain records of physical progress, manpower, equipment, quality issues, and site constraints.

· Provide verified information for project progress reports and management dashboards.

· Track outstanding issues, action owners, and target completion dates.

6. HSE Monitoring and Project Close-Out

· Monitor contractor compliance with site HSE requirements and escalate unsafe conditions.

· Verify completion of civil works, punch-list items, and defect rectification.

· Review as-built documentation and support inspection and handover activities.

Job Qualifications – Site Civil Supervisor

1. Education

• Bachelor's Degree (S1) in Civil Engineering or a related discipline.

2. Work Experience

• Minimum 3–5 years of experience in civil construction, site supervision, or construction management.
• Experience in building, industrial, infrastructure, or other relevant construction projects.
• Experience in supervising contractors from the Owner's or Consultant's side is preferred.

3. Technical Competencies

• Ability to read and interpret construction drawings, technical specifications, and method statements.
• Knowledge of civil construction methods, including earthworks, foundations, concrete works, structural works, masonry, roads, and drainage.
• Understanding of construction quality inspection, material testing, and non-conformance management.
• Ability to monitor physical progress and compare actual performance against approved construction schedules.
• Familiarity with construction safety requirements and applicable quality standards.
• Ability to identify construction deviations, technical issues, and potential schedule delays.

4. Reporting and Computer Skills

• Proficient in Microsoft Excel, Word, and other standard reporting tools.
• Ability to prepare daily site reports, weekly progress reports, inspection records, and photographic documentation.
• Ability to maintain issue registers and monitor corrective actions.
• Familiarity with AutoCAD for drawing review is preferred.
• Familiarity with Primavera P6 or Microsoft Project is an advantage.

5. Core Competencies

• Strong site supervision and observation skills.
• Good communication and coordination with contractors, consultants, and project teams.
• Analytical thinking and problem-solving skills.
• High attention to detail and commitment to quality and safety.
• Ability to work independently, prioritize site issues, and escalate risks appropriately.
• Integrity, accountability, and professional conduct.

6. Other Requirements

• Willing to work at project sites and travel between project locations as required.
• Physically fit to conduct routine site inspections.
• Able to work under project deadlines and changing site conditions.
• Professional proficiency in Bahasa Indonesia; working knowledge of English is an advantage.
